verdict.rationale: Chroma's docs say the product is Apache 2.0 licensed and can be run locally or self-hosted. The official CLI runs a local Chroma server, and community comments confirm a self-hostable open-source Apache 2.0 core. missing for 10: detailed first-party self-hosting deployment docs (e.g. Docker or cluster setup) in the evidence, and evidence of parity with Cloud, since community notes say better indexes and distributed scaling are Chroma Cloud features.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Chroma is licensed under Apache 2.0. Run it locally, self-host, or use Chroma Cloud for a managed, serverless experience.
The Chroma CLI lets you run a Chroma server locally on your machine
